findings: HIGH #1: Silent exception handlers exist at routes.py lines ~1177, ~1212, ~1248 (bare except: pass blocks swallowing DB errors) - design provides wrong line numbers and incorrect error types
HIGH #2: Migration 001 is for spatial validation (area_km2), not JWT validation - design conflates security and spatial concerns
HIGH #3: WebSocket implementation completely missing - no endpoints, connection manager, or auth flow provided despite detailed strategy description
HIGH #4: Hardcoded hex colors found throughout frontend (bg-[#775a19], bg-[#1a1c1c], etc.) in 6+ files - design focuses on non-existent emoji problem instead
HIGH #5: Validation strategy ambiguous - 'complex vs simple' undefined, management units hardcoded instead of queried from database
HIGH #6: ErrorResponse schema conflict - design version differs from existing response_schemas.py, no migration plan specified
HIGH #7: Redis fail-open lacks recovery strategy - no automatic reconnection, no alerting, in-memory fallback unsuitable for multi-instance production
HIGH #8: Phase dependencies incorrect - Phase 2 needs Phase 5 (spatial validation), Phase 4 needs Phase 3 (theme), timeline is wrong
MEDIUM #9: NASA POWER retry only in fetch_complete_nasa_data(), not in fetch_real_nasa_annual_rainfall() - partial verification
